_comment: Brand-agnostic fallback. Used whenever no --codex is supplied, so the linter works
with zero brand input and the skill is never blocked on onboarding a voice.
This file is hand-written, not extracted. It carries no brand voice on purpose:
total_words is 0, which tells the linter to keep the regime profile's own gates
rather than overriding them with measured brand numbers.
To get a real voice, put 3-5 verbatim published samples in
references/voice-samples-<brand>/ and run extract_voice_codex.py, then pass the
tone_descriptors: clarity-first (NN/g: clarity, then concision, then character)
jargon_tolerance: low — plain nouns unless the brief establishes a technical audience
metaphor_frequency: rare — prefer literal description until a voice codex says otherwise
